meaning.en: To arrive at once on hearing the news.
meaning.zh: 一听到消息就赶来。

equivalents: flock in on hearing the news

examples.zh: 新店打折的消息一出，顾客闻风而至。
examples.en: Once word of the discount got out, customers came flocking.

examples.zh: 各路记者闻风而至。
examples.en: Reporters from all sides rushed to the scene.

usage.en: Predicate; compare 闻风而动 (act on hearing).

meaning.en: A burglar (a humorous euphemism).
meaning.zh: 指小偷，带有诙谐意味。

examples.zh: 昨晚有梁上君子光顾了他家。
examples.en: A burglar paid his house a visit last night.

examples.zh: 小区加了监控，梁上君子无从下手。
examples.en: With cameras installed in the estate, burglars have no chance.

story.en: Chen Shi spotted a thief hiding on his beam and lectured his children that bad habits make 'the gentleman on the beam' (梁上君子); the thief repented.
story.zh: 《后汉书·陈寔传》：陈寔发现小偷藏在梁上，便教育子孙：“不善之人未必本恶，习以性成，遂至于此，梁上君子者是矣！”

meaning.en: Superiors and subordinates sharing the same aim.
meaning.zh: 上上下下的人想法一致、目标相同。

examples.zh: 全队上下同欲，才赢得了这场胜利。
examples.en: The whole team shared one aim, and that won the match.

examples.zh: 上下同欲者胜，这是管理的基本道理。
examples.en: Those united from top to bottom prevail; that is a basic principle of management.

story.en: Sunzi lists five ways to know victory, one being: 'those whose superiors and subordinates share the same desire will win' (上下同欲者胜).

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate; often 上下同欲者胜.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“上下同欲者胜”。

meaning.en: To give oneself away without being pressed.
meaning.zh: 没有拷问，自己就招认了，比喻无意中暴露了自己。

equivalents: let the cat out of the bag

examples.zh: 他一听警察问话，就不打自招了。
examples.en: As soon as the police questioned him, he confessed on his own.

examples.zh: 这番解释反倒是不打自招。
examples.en: That explanation only gave him away.

synonyms: 贼娃子说梦话——不打自招

meaning.en: Both the government and the public.
meaning.zh: 朝廷和民间，泛指政府和民众各界。

equivalents: from the court to the common people

examples.zh: 此事引起朝野上下的普遍关注。
examples.en: The matter drew widespread attention from government and public alike.

examples.zh: 朝野上下一致反对这项提案。
examples.en: Officials and ordinary people alike opposed the proposal.

usage.en: Noun phrase. 朝 here is read cháo.

meaning.en: Naturally formed and perfectly suited, as if made by heaven and earth.
meaning.zh: 自然形成的，非常合适，不需人工雕琢。

examples.zh: 这处山谷仿佛天造地设的天然屏障。
examples.en: The valley seems a natural barrier made by heaven and earth.

examples.zh: 他们俩真是天造地设的一对。
examples.en: The two are a perfect match, made for each other.

natural: skilled in both letters and arms

meaning.en: Accomplished in both scholarship and martial skill.
meaning.zh: 文才武略两方面都具备。

equivalents: accomplished in both letters and arms

examples.zh: 这位将军文武兼备，深受朝廷器重。
examples.en: The general excelled in both letters and arms and was highly valued.

examples.zh: 他文武兼备，既能写文章又能带兵。
examples.en: He combines the pen and the sword, able to write and to lead troops.

meaning.en: To focus on material things and neglect the human side.
meaning.zh: 只看到物，看不到人，指只重视物质而忽视人的作用。

equivalents: see the objects but not the people

examples.zh: 只抓指标，见物不见人，管理是搞不好的。
examples.en: Focusing only on targets and overlooking people will not make good management.

examples.zh: 扶贫不能见物不见人。
examples.en: Poverty relief must not look only at goods and forget the people.

usage.en: Used in management and policy talk; critical.
usage.zh: 多用于管理、政策讨论，含批评。

meaning.en: So forceful that nothing can stop it.
meaning.zh: 势头猛，不可抵挡。

examples.zh: 大军士气高昂，锐不可当。
examples.en: The army's spirits were high and its advance irresistible.

examples.zh: 他们锐不可当，一路杀进决赛。
examples.en: They were unstoppable and cut through to the final.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 当 is read dāng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。“当”读 dāng。

meaning.en: To visit a place one has been to before.
meaning.zh: 再次游览曾经去过的地方。

equivalents: go back to a familiar place

examples.zh: 毕业二十年后，他旧地重游，感慨万千。
examples.en: Twenty years after graduating, he revisited the old place, deeply moved.

examples.zh: 旧地重游，一切都变了样。
examples.en: Revisiting the old place, everything had changed.

natural: as if with a thorn in one's back

meaning.en: Extremely uneasy, as if thorns were pricking one's back.
meaning.zh: 像芒刺扎在背上，形容坐立不安。

examples.zh: 被领导盯着看，他如芒在背。
examples.en: With the boss's eyes on him, he felt on pins and needles.

examples.zh: 在这种场合，我总觉得如芒在背。
examples.en: On this kind of occasion I always feel ill at ease.

story.en: Emperor Xuan, newly enthroned, rode with the powerful Huo Guang and felt 'as though thorns were on his back' (若有芒刺在背).
story.zh: 《汉书·霍光传》：“宣帝始立，谒见高庙，大将军光从骖乘，上内严惮之，若有芒刺在背。”

usage.en: Predicate. Related to 如坐针毡.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。与“如坐针毡”意近。

meaning.en: Life is in imminent danger.
meaning.zh: 生命危在旦夕，形容生命垂危。

examples.zh: 病人命在旦夕，必须马上手术。
examples.en: The patient is at death's door and needs surgery at once.

examples.zh: 洪水来临，村民命在旦夕。
examples.en: With the flood coming, the villagers' lives hung by a thread.

pinyin: shǒu wú fù jī zhī lì
natural: too weak to tie up a chicken

meaning.en: Physically very weak.
meaning.zh: 手上没有捆住鸡的力气，形容体质弱，没有力量。

equivalents: too feeble to lift a finger

examples.zh: 他是个手无缚鸡之力的书生。
examples.en: He was a scholar with no strength to speak of.

examples.zh: 手无缚鸡之力的她，竟救起了落水的孩子。
examples.en: Though she looked frail, she managed to rescue the child who had fallen in.

antonyms: 鲁智深倒拔垂杨柳——力大无穷

literal: be close to · the humane · be good to · neighbours
natural: befriend the kind and be good to neighbours

meaning.en: To befriend the virtuous and live in harmony with neighbours.
meaning.zh: 亲近仁义的人，和邻国或邻居友好相处。

examples.zh: 我国一贯奉行亲仁善邻的外交政策。
examples.en: Our country has always pursued a policy of good neighbourliness.

examples.zh: 亲仁善邻，是邻里相处的好办法。
examples.en: Being kind and friendly is a good way to get along with neighbours.

story.en: 'To be close to the humane and good to one's neighbours is a treasure of the state' (亲仁善邻，国之宝也).
story.zh: 《左传·隐公六年》：“亲仁善邻，国之宝也。”

natural: impossible to escape even with wings

meaning.en: Impossible to escape, even with wings.
meaning.zh: 即使长了翅膀也难以逃脱，形容无法逃走。

examples.zh: 警方已包围了大楼，嫌犯插翅难逃。
examples.en: The police surrounded the building and the suspect has no way out.

examples.zh: 证据确凿，他插翅难逃。
examples.en: With the evidence conclusive, there's no escape for him.

usage.zh: 多作谓语。也说“插翅难飞”。

meaning.en: A tiny patch of land, only enough to stand an awl on.
meaning.zh: 插一把锥子那么大的地方，形容极小的地方。

examples.zh: 会场挤得没有立锥之地。
examples.en: The hall was so crowded there was no room to stand.

examples.zh: 他穷得连立锥之地也没有。
examples.en: He was so poor he didn't have a plot of land to his name.

meaning.en: A New Year wish: the year begins with good fortune.
meaning.zh: 旧时用作新年祝颂语，表示吉祥亨通。

equivalents: a lucky start to the year
good fortune in the new year

examples.zh: 春联上写着“三阳开泰”。
examples.en: The spring couplet read 'three yang open the year'.

examples.zh: 祝大家三阳开泰，万事如意！
examples.en: Wishing everyone a lucky year and all the best!

usage.en: New Year greeting; written 三羊开泰 in Year-of-the-Sheep decorations.
usage.zh: 新年祝语；羊年常写作“三羊开泰”。

pinyin: gè rén zì sǎo mén qián xuě
literal: each · person · sweeps · own · door · front · snow

meaning.en: Everyone sweeps only their own doorstep: each minds their own business and no one else's.
meaning.zh: 各人只管自己门前的雪，比喻只顾自己，不管别人。

examples.zh: 各人自扫门前雪，这种态度可不行。
examples.en: 'Everyone sweeps their own doorstep' is the wrong attitude.

examples.zh: 邻里之间不能各人自扫门前雪。
examples.en: Neighbours shouldn't each sweep only their own front step.

usage.en: Usually followed by 莫管他人瓦上霜; critical of indifference.
usage.zh: 后面常接“莫管他人瓦上霜”，批评冷漠。

meaning.en: Those who are slow must start early to keep up.
meaning.zh: 能力差的人要先行动，多下功夫，才能赶上别人。

equivalents: make up for it with hard work

examples.zh: 我基础差，只能笨鸟先飞。
examples.en: My foundation is weak, so I have to start early and work harder.

examples.zh: 笨鸟先飞，他每天比别人早到一小时。
examples.en: He compensates by arriving an hour earlier than everyone else every day.

usage.en: Often a humble self-description; full saying 笨鸟先飞早入林.
usage.zh: 常作谦辞；全句为“笨鸟先飞早入林”。

meaning.en: Backed by proof and evidence.
meaning.zh: 有证据，有根据。

examples.zh: 他的说法有凭有据，不容置疑。
examples.en: His account is well-founded and beyond doubt.

examples.zh: 做报道要有凭有据。
examples.en: Reports must be backed by evidence.

natural: carry on as if it were the end of the world

meaning.en: To make a huge fuss, as if one would die; or to an extreme degree.
meaning.zh: 形容闹得很凶，或程度很深。

examples.zh: 她为这事哭得要死要活。
examples.en: She cried as if her heart would break over it.

examples.zh: 别为了一点小事就要死要活的。
examples.en: Don't make such a fuss over a small thing.

meaning.en: Haughty and rude.
meaning.zh: 态度傲慢，不讲礼貌。

examples.zh: 他对客人傲慢无礼，被投诉了。
examples.en: He was arrogant and rude to the guests and got complaints.

examples.zh: 傲慢无礼的态度让人反感。
examples.en: An arrogant, rude manner puts people off.

meaning.en: Honest words that are unpleasant to hear but good for one.
meaning.zh: 听起来不舒服但对人有益的话。

equivalents: advice one doesn't want to hear

examples.zh: 好的领导者愿意听逆耳之言。
examples.en: Good leaders are willing to hear unwelcome truths.

examples.zh: 他不爱听逆耳之言，身边尽是奉承者。
examples.en: He dislikes hard truths and is surrounded by flatterers.

usage.en: Noun phrase; from 忠言逆耳.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，出自“忠言逆耳”。
